title: 先有分数对，再有分数
Start with pairs, then fractions
text: 整环 D 中先考虑全部有序对 (a,b)，b≠0，再用交叉相乘定义等价关系。a/b 表示这个等价类，不是尚未定义的除法。
For a domain D, start with pairs (a,b) with b≠0, and define equivalence by cross multiplication. The notation a/b denotes an equivalence class, not a pre-existing division operation.
proof: 自反与对称直接成立。若 ad=bc、cf=de，则 adf=bcf=bde。
Reflexivity and symmetry are immediate. If ad=bc and cf=de, then adf=bcf=bde.
因 d≠0 且 D 无零因子，消去 d 得 af=be，证明传递性。
Since d≠0 and D has no zero-divisors, cancellation gives af=be, proving transitivity.
warning: 无零因子条件用于传递性，也保证后续分母的积不为零。不能直接对任意环照搬。
The domain hypothesis is used in transitivity and to keep products of denominators nonzero.

title: 在等价类上定义加法与乘法
Operations on equivalence classes
text: 先确认 bd≠0，再验证换代表不改变结果；这两步通过后，才能把熟悉的分式规则视为真正的运算。
First check bd≠0, then prove that changing representatives leaves the result unchanged. Only then do the familiar fraction formulas define operations.
proof: 设 ab′=a′b、cd′=c′d。由于是整环，bd 与 b′d′ 都非零。
Suppose ab′=a′b and cd′=c′d. The domain property keeps both product denominators nonzero.
乘法：acb′d′=a′c′bd，故 ac/(bd) 与 a′c′/(b′d′) 等价。
Multiplication is well-defined since acb′d′=a′c′bd.
加法：(ad+bc)b′d′=(a′d′+b′c′)bd，展开后分别用两条假设即可。
For addition, expand (ad+bc)b′d′=(a′d′+b′c′)bd and use the two assumptions.
所以两种运算都与代表元无关。
Both operations are independent of representatives.

title: 把所有非零分母变得可逆
A field containing the domain
text: 分数类构成域，零元 0/1、单位元 1/1、负元 −a/b；非零类 a/b 的逆为 b/a。自然映射 a↦a/1 是单同态，因此每个整环可嵌入一个域。
Fraction classes form a field, with zero 0/1, identity 1/1, negative −a/b and inverse b/a for a nonzero fraction. The map a↦a/1 is an embedding, so every domain embeds in a field.
proof: 加法结合律的两个括号都化为 (adf+bcf+bde)/(bdf)；乘法两个括号都为 ace/(bdf)。交换律继承自 D。
Both associations of a/b+c/d+e/f give (adf+bcf+bde)/(bdf). Products give ace/(bdf); commutativity is inherited.
分配律两侧通分都得到 a(cf+de)/(bdf)。零元、负元、单位元直接代入验证。
Distributivity reduces both sides to a(cf+de)/(bdf). Substitute to verify zero, negatives and identity.
a/b=0/1 当且仅当 a=0；否则 b/a 合法且乘积为 1。1/1≠0/1，因为 D 中 1≠0。
A fraction is zero exactly when its numerator is zero. Otherwise b/a is a valid inverse; 1/1≠0/1.
a↦a/1 保运算；若 a/1=b/1，则 a=b，所以单射。
The natural map preserves operations and is injective by cross multiplication.

title: 商域不是商环
Fields of fractions and quotient rings differ
text: 商域包含原整环并允许所有非零元素作分母。商环 R/I 则把 I 压成零，两者是不同构造。整环 D 的商域由全部 a/b 组成。
The field of fractions contains the original domain and allows all nonzero denominators. A quotient ring R/I instead collapses I to zero. These are different constructions.
example: Frac(ℤ[i])=ℚ(i)，Frac(ℤ[x])=ℚ(x)，Frac(F)=F（F 已是域）。ℚ(x) 中 (x²−1)/(x−1)=x+1 是形式分式的等式；作为部分定义函数时要另外说明定义域。
Frac(ℤ[i])=ℚ(i), Frac(ℤ[x])=ℚ(x), and Frac(F)=F for a field. In ℚ(x), (x²−1)/(x−1)=x+1 as formal fractions; domains of partial functions are a separate matter.

title: 任何嵌入都唯一延伸到分数
Embeddings extend uniquely to fractions
text: 若 K 为域且 ι:D→K 是单同态，则它唯一延伸为 Frac(D)→K 的单同态。因此在给定 D 的嵌入后，商域是必须包含的最小子域。
An embedding of a domain D into a field K extends uniquely to an embedding of Frac(D) into K. Relative to the given copy of D, the fraction field is the smallest required subfield.

label: 补充 · 商域的最小性
Supplementary result

proof: ι 单射且 D 非零，故 ι(1)≠0；它是幂等元，域中只有非零幂等元 1，所以 ι(1)=1。
Injectivity gives ι(1)≠0; this idempotent must be 1 in the field K.
b≠0 给出 ι(b)≠0；若 ad=bc，应用 ι 后交叉相乘即可验证分数像与代表无关。
Nonzero b has nonzero image. Applying ι to ad=bc proves independence of representatives.
分式运算说明延拓保运算；核为零，因为像为零迫使 ι(a)=0，从而 a=0。
Fraction arithmetic proves compatibility, and a zero image forces the numerator to be zero, giving injectivity.
任何延拓必须把 b⁻¹ 送到 ι(b)⁻¹，再把 a/b 送到指定值，故唯一。每个含 D 的子域都包含这些值。
Any extension must preserve the inverse of b, so its value on a/b is forced. Every subfield containing D contains these fractions.

title: 同构的整环有同构的商域
Isomorphic domains have isomorphic fraction fields
text: 给定 φ:D→D′ 的同构，商域之间的同构由 a/b↦φ(a)/φ(b) 给出。须同时检查分母非零、良定义与逆映射。
An isomorphism φ:D→D′ induces a/b↦φ(a)/φ(b). Check nonzero denominators, independence of representatives and the inverse map.
proof: φ 单射保证非零分母仍非零；ad=bc 经 φ 化为 φ(a)φ(d)=φ(b)φ(c)，所以良定义。
Injectivity preserves nonzero denominators; applying φ to ad=bc proves well-definedness.
用分式的加法、乘法公式直接验证保运算。
The fraction formulas verify preservation of addition and multiplication.
对 φ⁻¹ 用同样构造，两个映射互为逆，从而是同构。
The same construction for φ⁻¹ provides the inverse.

question: 分数对 (a,b) 与 (c,d) 何时等价？
When are fraction pairs (a,b) and (c,d) equivalent?
reason: 商域构造使用交叉相乘；分母都必须非零。
Use cross multiplication, with both denominators nonzero.

question: Frac(ℤ[x]) 是什么？
What is Frac(ℤ[x])?
reason: 整数系数多项式之比等价于有理系数多项式之比，清分母即可。
Ratios of integer-coefficient polynomials give all rational functions over ℚ after clearing denominators.

question: 商域构造中，哪一步必须使用无零因子？
Which step needs the absence of zero-divisors?
options: 保证非零分母之积非零
Keeping products of nonzero denominators nonzero
reason: 分母积必须仍能作分母；等价关系的传递性也用到消去律。
Denominator products must remain admissible; transitivity also uses cancellation.

question: a/b≠0 时，其逆元是？
If a/b≠0, what is its inverse?
reason: 非零分式的分子 a≠0，因此 b/a 合法，且乘积等于 1。
The numerator a is nonzero, so b/a is valid and multiplies to 1.

question: 证明 Frac(ℤ[i])=ℚ(i)，分别说明两个包含关系。
Prove Frac(ℤ[i])=ℚ(i), explaining both inclusions.
reason: 高斯整数之比乘以分母共轭，可写成有理实部与虚部，所以属于 ℚ(i)。反向 a/b+(c/d)i=(ad+bci)/(bd)，其中分子分母为高斯整数且 bd≠0。
Rationalize a ratio of Gaussian integers using the conjugate denominator to obtain rational real and imaginary parts. Conversely a/b+(c/d)i=(ad+bci)/(bd) is a ratio of Gaussian integers.
